datasets.name: Copernicus DEM GLO-30
datasets.notes: Copernicus DEM GLO-30, produced by ESA/Airbus from TanDEM-X; free and open licence (COPERNICUS DEM, (c) DLR e.V. 2010-2014 and (c) Airbus Defence and Space GmbH 2014-2018, provided under COPERNICUS by the EU and ESA).

provenance.processing: Copernicus DEM GLO-30 (30 m geographic grid) block-averaged to about 200 m (rasterio Resampling.average, the same method as the Mars scan) and bilinearly sampled on a local equirectangular grid (dx = 200 m / (111320 cos lat), dy = 200 m / 110540), 150 by 150 pixels = 30 km square, north-up, elevation in metres above EGM2008. Built to sit beside the Mars HRSC+MOLA 200 m window (mars-oxia) at the same scale. Source: AWS open bucket.

checkAgainstRun.note: The run used common.slope_degrees and a 30 km block grid; slope here is numpy central differences on this exact grid, so small differences are expected.

stats.method: Central finite differences (numpy.gradient) at 200 m spacing, slope = atan(|grad|) in degrees; histogram has 45 bins of 1 deg from 0 to 45 (steeper pixels counted in the last bin), values are fractions summing to 1. Relief = 95th minus 5th percentile of elevation. Same code for Earth, Moon and Mars.
